name: Pipi
source:
[url=/c27]Yagami Coco[/url]'s dog.

[spoiler]A robot dog that Coco owns. In the [url=/v19373]Remake[/url], she was created by [url=/c103516]Tanaka Youichi[/url] and designated LM-QSS17. [url=/c32]Akanegasaki Sora[/url] describes PiPi as her "younger sister," and the two share the same computer/body after the 2017 incident.[/spoiler]
